name: boss-7
about: Boss Rush: Longevity Lich (a crowned skeleton with an hourglass heart). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss07-lich-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
